Data contract & Python connection

The normalized schema is source, id, symbol, price, size, timestamp. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds; price and size must be positive finite numbers. Duplicate detection uses source + ID over the last 10,000 accepted IDs. Late ticks are retained but do not replace a source’s newer quote. The consolidated price uses the newest source quote by event time.

Processing p95 measures browser normalization and insertion, not network latency. These are generated prices, not exchange quotes. No orders or trading connections exist.

The repository also contains a Python asyncio pipeline with three actual local WebSocket feeds, SQLite storage and a normalized WebSocket output. When serving this page through that Python app, connect to its stream below. On the hosted demo this endpoint is unavailable; browser simulation remains functional.
